pages.title: Reuse Nearby Terrain
pages.text: Auram reduces repeated density-graph mapping and reuses bounded terrain samples during selected structure searches.$(br2)Targets include AE2 meteorites, Lithostitched jigsaw assemblies, Mowzie’s Wroughtnaut searches and Malum wells. Mutable sampling state belongs to the operation using it, rather than a global world cache.

pages.title: Skip Unneeded Samples
pages.text: Nether fossil searches avoid full columns when a candidate can already be rejected. Malum wells stop when their original threshold is decided and sample only needed states.$(br2)Nyctophobia mushroom placement checks the height threshold without always constructing a full column. Custom generator contexts keep their original path where the optimized sampler is unsupported.
